proof: REG-B64 x6 jest: the CANCELLED branch now returns the creation-time stock decrement through the EXISTING settleStockForEdit (empty final item set), so each product is credited max(0, qty - deliveredQty) under the same FOR UPDATE lock — delivered goods are never invented back onto the shelf — and surviving OrderItems flip to CANCELLED AFTER the invoice voids (call-order oracle asserts both entries exist, not just their indexOf order). reopenOrder reads those item-CANCELLED lines BEFORE reverting them and re-decrements exactly what the cancel credited. REVIEW CAUGHT A DEFECT IN THE FIRST IMPLEMENTATION: it flipped lines unconditionally, so a DRAFT cancel (which correctly credits nothing) still marked its lines, and reopen then decremented stock the draft never held — understating currentStock by the full order quantity on a cancel->reopen round trip. Credit and mark are now ONE decision (cancelReturnsStock), pinned by T7. No StockMovement rows — matches create()/edit, which track currentStock only. Mutation-probed x2 (remove the credit-back -> red; make the flip unconditional -> red).

proof: REG-B116 x4 jest: order create's stock transaction now opens with an explicit { timeout: 20000, maxWait: 5000 } instead of inheriting Prisma 7's 5s interactive-transaction ceiling, and the sequential per-line tx.product.update loop is replaced by ONE set-based UPDATE ... FROM (VALUES ...) — with per-product qty AGGREGATED first, which is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: the join applies at most one row per key, so two lines of the same product must decrement their sum. The oracle counts occurrences (a per-line statement would name the product twice and never bind the sum) AND pins the arithmetic direction, so a sign flip cannot stay green. Review added a tenantId predicate the raw statement needs for itself: raw SQL bypasses the tenant proxy that scoped the ORM call it replaced. R16's retry, which the test plan wrongly claimed was already pinned elsewhere (no such test existed in apps/api), now has a real pin (T24). Mutation-probed x2 (flip the sign -> red; drop the timeout budget -> red).
